key_points: HSBC executed buyback of 400,400 shares on Sept 18 (HK$65M) and 1.88M shares weekly
Cumulative buyback has erased 39M+ shares, signaling capital return commitment
CFO Pam Kaur emphasized Hong Kong, wealth management, trade finance and UK as growth priorities
Upcoming Q3 results anticipated with buybacks providing near-term stock support
